name: Tesla Model 3 (2017)
assembly: Fremont, California, United States (Tesla Fremont Factory)

length.sourceNote: Published as 184.8 in and converted at 25.4 mm/in. The 2023 facelift is longer, at 4,720 mm.

width.sourceNote: Published as 72.8 in, excluding mirrors, and converted at 25.4 mm/in.

height.sourceNote: Published as 56.8 in and converted at 25.4 mm/in.

wheelbase.sourceNote: Published as 113.2 in and converted at 25.4 mm/in.

engine.configuration: single motor, interior permanent magnet synchronous reluctance

power.sourceNote: Tesla publishes no power figure for the Model 3. The EPA vehicle record for the 2018 Long Range gives the motor as 202 kW, which is the only public-domain figure for it.

mass.sourceNote: Published as 3,805 lb and converted at 0.45359237 kg/lb.

topSpeed.sourceNote: Published as 140 mph and converted exactly. Tesla quotes 0-60 mph in 5.0 s; that is not a 0-100 km/h time and is deliberately not recorded as one.

batteryCapacity.sourceNote: Usable capacity of the pre-2021 Long Range pack. Cars built from 2021 used an 82 kWh pack.

electricRange.sourceNote: EPA combined range, published as 310 miles and converted at 1.609344 km/mi. A WLTP figure of 580 km is published for the same car; the two cycles are not comparable.

electricConsumption.sourceNote: EPA combined 25.88 kWh/100 mi, converted at 1.609344 km/mi. Measured at the wall, so it includes charging losses.

dragCoefficient.sourceNote: Listed for the Tesla Model 3, 2017. The list records it as a manufacturer press-kit figure.

trims.name: Performance AWD
trims.transmission: Single-speed fixed reduction, one motor per axle

engine.configuration: dual motor - synchronous reluctance rear, induction front

power.sourceNote: Natural Resources Canada rates the 2018–2020 Model 3 Long Range AWD Performance at 358 kW combined: a single regulator-published system output, not the sum of two motor ratings, which is why it can be recorded where the EPA per-motor figures could not be. The same table rates the 2021–2023 Performance at 321 kW, so this trim did not hold one output for its whole run; 358 kW describes the earlier car. The non-Performance Long Range AWD is rated 335 kW.

mass.sourceNote: Published as 4,072 lb and converted at 0.45359237 kg/lb.

topSpeed.sourceNote: Published as 155 mph and converted exactly.

batteryCapacity.sourceNote: Cars built from 2021. Earlier Performance cars used the 75 kWh pack.
